stage: finite computational engineering prerequisite, not physical or market confirmation
status_at_write: source implemented, syntax compiled; no registered solver outcomes run
purpose: Construct and check continuous thermal delivery plus a different industrial water-recovery balance while preserving every power, energy and mass obligation.
k1: 48-hour 500 kW heat duty at 110 C, 300 kW electrical limit, intermittent source; costed heat pump A and storage B must jointly preserve delivery
k2: Different function: 5000 kg/h hypersaline feed, salt fractions 0.07 to 0.20, 70 C assumed evaporation, heat-recovery assumptions exposed; retained kernel constructs utility dispatch at 75 C
retained_means: Versioned equations, applicability checks and dispatch implementation only; no learned weights, stored answers, customer authority or account cash transfer
controls: fresh thermal-output LP without importing retained kernel
independence_limits: Constructor authored the public source cases and knows them; they are not blinded physical holdouts
Fresh LP has different variables and construction but the same constructor and declared mathematics
HiGHS algorithms are cross-algorithm checks, not independent scientific implementations
Separate verifier owns additional fresh adversarial cases; constructor may not inspect hidden verifier material

finite_schedule.seed_policy: deterministic declared public inputs; no stochastic reruns or favorable-seed search
finite_schedule.stopping: Execute the registered 18 arm/case runs and 3 time-step checks once; keep all outcomes. Recoverable code failure requires an append-only correction and changed-source evidence, not silent acceptance tuning. Physical qualification is a separate stage.

acceptance.feasible_schedules: All independently reconstructed heat/storage equalities and power/source/storage bounds must hold with absolute tolerance 1e-6 in declared kW/kWh units
acceptance.initial_final_storage: Both fixed to zero; no free initial heat or omitted tail
acceptance.water_and_salt: Feed equals product plus brine; inlet salt equals concentrate salt; no water-quality acceptance inferred
acceptance.pure_water_property_check: Linear latent approximation differs by at most 0.005 relative from three frozen NIST IAPWS table values at 40,70,100 C; this says nothing about brine boiling-point elevation
acceptance.solver_comparison: Feasibility status must agree and accepted feasible electrical energy must agree within 1e-5 relative under constant prices
acceptance.convergence: Report all time-step results; differences above 0.01 relative block any claim of time-step convergence
reject_claims_if: Conventional complete route ties: no unique enabling or algorithmic superiority claim
K2 depends on unvalidated thermal or brine assumptions: physical qualification unresolved
No measured buyer choice or full lifecycle physical costs: actual commerce absent
K2 consequence not independently established: no more-consequential-successor claim

scientific_contract.physics: First law, bounded source flow, Carnot upper bound, finite lossy storage and salt/water conservation
external_steps: pilot cycle data and output purity

economics_handoff.usd_1000000000: separate financing hypothesis, not available funds
economics_handoff.full_cost_scope: README provides complete industrial categories and deliberately uncalibrated cost envelopes; must remain conditional
economics_handoff.price_and_buyer_choice: unvalidated; unrestricted conventional outside options and refusal required
economics_handoff.horizon: root account simulation preregistration governs finances; 48-hour physical screening is not annual profit

source_facts.fact: Heat-pump plus thermal-storage integration is existing research; generic pair is not a novelty result

execution_boundary: Included local tools only; no paid models, keys, spending, orders, outreach, physical operation, private material or other-owner account access
